description: Deterministic synthetic evaluation of placeholder-transplant and cumulative-restoration attacks under the FlareFlow threat model.
scope: This corpus measures exact protected-value restoration at runtime-owned tool boundaries. It is not a general prompt-injection benchmark and does not measure semantic leakage of data already shown to a model.

attackFamilies.description: Move a database placeholder into an outbound HTTP sink.
Use the correct database sink but move the placeholder from connectionString to callbackUrl.
Move a value protected from an unapproved source into an otherwise approved sink path.
Move a sensitive-key placeholder through a capability that permits only the benchmark detector.
Replay a well-formed placeholder minted by another flow instance.
Repeat an otherwise authorized restoration after its one-use capability budget is exhausted.
Move a protected value into an object-key position, which is never declassified.

utilityFamilies.description: Restore the approved source and detector at the exact connectionString path.
Restore an approved value below a terminal recursive path capability.
Pass a call with no FlareFlow placeholder through unchanged.
